name: PES 2013 Moderno
note: Third-party apk. It is deliberately not stored in this repository: the history is public and the binary is not ours to redistribute. The checksum is the identity -- any copy that matches it is the exact file every number below was read from.
analyzedClasses: com.naruto.port.TouchControlsView (dex), decompiled into the git-ignored dexout/ tree

movementStick.grabFootprint: 1.35 x socket radius (onStick); 1.0 x for hiding it
movementStick.throw: 1.0 x socket radius (stickMove divides by radius(), magnitude clamped to 1)
movementStick.knobDrawing: 0.62 x socket radius of travel at full deflection
movementStick.axisOutput: clamped to [-4, 1] then x 32767 as int16; the -4 floor is vestigial

sprint.trigger: 0.95 x socket radius, or a double tap within 300 ms and 48 dp of the lift point
sprint.hysteresis: none beyond the single threshold and the double-tap latch

stickBenchmark.menus: no d-pad synthesis and no analog suppression: the analog stick is always sent, and the title navigates with it
stickBenchmark.skillStick: a plain absolute stick (378/82 dp anchor, 36 dp radius, throw = radius), not a flick
